examName: Developing AI Cloud Solutions on Azure
note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for AI-200. Like SC-500, AI-300 and AZ-802, this study guide carries no 'Skills measured as of <date>' line — Microsoft publishes a single undated skills list for it, and the exam is in beta. Re-check learn.microsoft.com before the exam.

domains.name: Develop containerized solutions on Azure
subtopics: Build, store, version, and manage container images by using Azure Container Registry
Build and run images by using Azure Container Registry Tasks
Deploy containers to Azure App Service, including environment variables and secrets
Deploy applications to Azure Container Apps, including environment configuration and revision management
Implement event-driven scaling by using KEDA in Container Apps
Deploy and manage applications to Azure Kubernetes Service by using manifest files
Monitor and troubleshoot solutions on AKS and Container Apps by inspecting logs, events, and connectivity

domains.name: Develop AI solutions by using Azure data management services
subtopics: Connect to Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL by using the SDK and run queries
Optimise query performance and request unit consumption with indexing policies and consistency levels
Store and retrieve embeddings and execute vector similarity search in Cosmos DB
Implement a change feed processor to detect and handle new or updated items
Connect and query Azure Database for PostgreSQL by using SDKs
Model schemas and implement indexing strategies, including reducing pgvector compute overhead
Configure compute, memory, and storage resources to support vector workloads
Run vector similarity search and implement RAG patterns with metadata filtering
Implement connection optimisation to improve throughput and minimise latency
Implement Azure Managed Redis data operations including caching, expiration, invalidation, and vector indexing

domains.name: Connect to and consume Azure services
subtopics: Queue and process back-end operations by using Azure Service Bus
Handle dead-letter queues, messages, topics, and subscriptions
Implement event-driven workflows by using Azure Event Grid
Configure Event Grid filters, custom events, and retries
Build serverless APIs by implementing triggers and bindings in Azure Functions
Configure and deploy function apps

domains.name: Secure, monitor, and troubleshoot Azure solutions
subtopics: Secure secrets by using Azure Key Vault, including rotation and retrieval
Store and retrieve application configuration by using Azure App Configuration
Trace distributed systems by using OpenTelemetry SDKs
Write KQL queries to analyse logs and metrics
Diagnose container and platform failures from logs and events
